reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 compares an Al,C-doped non-equiatomic alloy to the equiatomic quinary, showing later twinning in the doped alloy, but does not measure SFE or compare equiatomic subsets. E2 discusses a phase transformation in CrCoNi and notes Mn eliminates the fcc-hcp energy difference, but does not provide SFE values or link SFE to twin vs. glide balance across the proposed alloy series. The premises thus lack specific prior evidence.

Mn and Fe content modulates SFE, with the quinary having lower SFE
Lower SFE promotes easier twin nucleation and higher twin density
Higher SFE in quaternary/ternary alloys leads to early dislocation glide and delayed twinning
